steps.content: The Ferris wheel turns slowly at the end of the procession of monsters. The colorful lights blink, illuminating the gigantic mass of contamination sitting on the frame of the Ferris wheel. From the mass of contamination protrude tentacles left and right, like dancing flames, like carousing crowds.
The rose-red bubble in the heart of contamination stirs. Phantom Hamel is leaning against the bubble. The army of Corruptors comes to her. They lie prone before her and make pitiful appeals.

steps.speaker: Empty Mascot
steps.content: I... I feel so empty, I have nothing... Hamel, I have nothing...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: What do you want then? Um... you don't seem to remember what you want.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: All right then... I'll give you money! Money can buy you anything. Come to the dreamworld. I can give you anything you want.

steps.speaker: Empty Mascot
steps.content: Money... That's right. It's money!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Are you satisfied now? So... do you love me?
Tentacles rush out from under her dress and run into the Corruptor's mouth and nostrils, sucking the last bit of its life force while it's still in its sweet dream.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Hahaha... Next! What do you want?

steps.speaker: Sad Mascot
steps.content: My love... is gone... I can't find my love...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: What should we do? I don't know what she looks like... Uh, I'll give you good wine and beautiful women.

steps.speaker: Sad Mascot
steps.content: Um, that will make me forget my love... T-This isn't my love...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Is it so bad to forget? A new love... isn't that nice? Your new love can make you happy just like your old love did. Be happy again... isn't this the reason you're here?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Come now, cheer up. I helped you, now you should love me!
Yet another pathetic offering. The tentacles suck dry all its life force. The rose-red bubble is swelling up, as if something is about to burst out of it.
But Phantom Hamel is tired. She sits slumped, fiddling with her dance dress woven from the life force of Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: How many already?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I've waited so long... I'm finally free. All of you have come to keep me company, all of you love me. But why it's still not enough... why...?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I've surely become you, but why, why am I still feeling so lonely?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: In what manner did they used to love you? What is love? What kind of love can fill up the void of loneliness in my heart?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: What else do I need to become you?
Nightmare assails the Ferris wheel, making a loud bang. Phantom Hamel looks down.
She sees among the mass of monsters, the trio who're not under her control.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Ah, I get it now. I need companions. Ones as powerful as me, and as lonely.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: At long last! you're finally here, ${PlayerName}, my only worthy friend!
The ground gives way and turns into squirmy mud, black tentacles reaching up to drag you under.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: This time, I won't take no for an answer. Okay?

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Chief!
${PlayerName}, no!
You use your power to free the Sinners from the tentacles. You, on the other hand, are entombed in mud.
